title: Quantitative Ability
description: Arithmetic, percentages and data for the maths section.

topics.title: Percentages
topics.description: Find percentages fast, including increases and decreases.

lessons.title: Percentages
lessons.objective: Find percentages fast, including increases and decreases.

activities.title: Percent means per hundred
activities.body: 25% means 25 out of every 100. To find a percentage of a number, multiply by the percentage and divide by 100.

activities.title: Use 10% as a shortcut
activities.body: 10% of any number is that number divided by 10. Build other percentages from it: 5% is half of 10%, and 20% is double.

activities.hint: 25% is the same as one quarter.

activities.prompt: A price rises from Rs. 500 to Rs. 600. What is the percentage increase?
activities.hint: Compare the change with the original price.
activities.explanation: The increase is Rs. 100 on an original Rs. 500, and 100 ÷ 500 = 20%.

questions.prompt: A salary of Rs. 20,000 increases by 15%. What is the new salary?
questions.explanation: 15% of 20,000 is 3,000, so the new salary is Rs. 23,000.

questions.prompt: A Rs. 1,200 phone is sold at a 25% discount. What is the sale price?
questions.explanation: 25% of 1,200 is 300, so the sale price is 1,200 − 300 = Rs. 900.
